text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to remove a designated on-street accessible loading zone, on the east side of Delaware Avenue, south of Hallam Street. The accessible permit holder who originally requested the loading zone has passed away and the space is no longer required.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible loading zone that operates from 7:30 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and from 3:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Delaware Avenue, from a point 147 metres south of Hallam Street to a point 5.5 metres further south.
